title: fix: count quest issues toward reporter rewards
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Let a quest issue count toward the separate 3-Pollen reporter reward when a merged PR fixes it.
- Keep app submissions, draft quests, and automated issues excluded.
- Update the quest text and regression test.

The reporter reward remains separate from the merged-PR author's quest reward. Existing qualifying quest issues may become eligible retroactively on the reporter's next quest check.

gist.headline: Two rewards, one fixed issue
gist.blurb: Reporting a quest issue counts too: when a merged PR fixes it, the reporter can claim a separate 3-Pollen reward. The PR author’s quest reward stays their own.
gist.summary: Quest issues count toward the separate 3-Pollen reporter reward when a merged PR fixes them; app submissions, draft quests, and automated issues remain excluded.
gist.impact: Reporters of qualifying quest issues, including existing ones, can become eligible for 3 Pollen on their next quest check without affecting the merged-PR author’s reward.
gist.visual_concept: Show a quest issue being fixed in a garden workshop, with two distinct Pollen tokens: one for the issue reporter and one for the PR author. Polli checks the issue with a tiny clipboard; code-plants and flowers keep the scene grounded in the project’s garden imagery.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy garden workshop, Polli checks a fixed quest-issue card with a tiny clipboard while two separate Pollen tokens rest beside blooming code-plants. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never oversized or elongated, and strictly pixel art. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, chunky retro sprites, soft pastel gradients over a prominent lime green (#ecf874) and warm cream background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; nostalgic and emotionally warm.
